Messages.Author: DaLurka
Messages.Body:
I have a 3 more questions:

Action Modifier:
1. I have heard that a Bleed Action can only be modified once.
So i cant play Bonding and Conditioning on the same Action. Correct?
But with different minions i could.
I havent read this in the rules. Or have i missed it?
Are there more exceptions?

2. If an action is successful (after all blocks are failed) can i play a Action Modifier directly before resolving the Action?

3. Is decline a block and failed block the same?
i.e. to Play Deflection.
If i try to block and raise my intercept +1 my pred increase stealth +2. I declare the block is failed. Can i then play Deflection?

Thx for helping.

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
1. Correct, you cannot play two (limited) bleed modifiers. There's no way to play bleed modifiers with multiple minions on the same action (under normal circumstances). Only the acting minion can modify the action.

2. An action is not necessarily successful just because there are no blockers. A bleed can be bounced (e.g. with Deflection), and the next target could block it. But you *can* play modifiers after blocks are declined or are unsuccessful - which I suspect is what you were wondering.

3. Yes, they are essentially the same. You never "stop" blocking - you just decline to increase intercept further to make it succeed. Note that some other player could force you to gain intercept, causing you to succeed even though you didn't want or intend to.

Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body:
To be clear on 2, this is a common sequence:

A bleeds.
B attempts to block.
A modifies for +stealth.
B declines to block.
A modifies for +bleed.
B plays Deflection.
C is now being bled for lots, with stealth.

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
> Snodig wrote:
> 1. Correct, you cannot play two (limited) bleed modifiers.
>
There few odd cards that enable you to bypass this.

Such as:

Command of the Beast
"Only usable during a bleed action.
dom +1 bleed (limited).
DOM +1 bleed that does not count against the limit."

> Snodig wrote:
> Only the acting minion can modify the action.
>
Again there are a few cards to bypass this.

Some of the very limited number of such cards are:

Empowering the Puppet King
"Only usable during a bleed action by a ready unlocked vampire other than the acting minion.
dom The acting minion gets +1 bleed (limited).
DOM As above, but usable by a ready locked vampire."

Cloak the Gathering:
"obf: +1 stealth.
OBF Only usable by a ready vampire other than the acting minion. The acting minion gets +1 stealth."

Touch of Clarity:
"Usable by an acting minion or any ready unlocked minion.
dem: Cancel a non-combat card requiring Dementation , Dominate or Presence as it is played, and its cost is not paid. Lock this vampire.
DEM: As above, but do not lock this vampire.
